header.name: Joining sentences
header.description: Join two ideas in one sentence with {qui}, {que}, {où}, {dont}, {ce qui} and {ce que}, and say what happens if something is true.
header.can_do: describe people, places and things in one sentence and make plans that depend on something else
header.can_do_example_fr: Je suis {name}. C'est mon amie qui parle français. Si tu veux, on y va.
